Package paint.compare

Interface FieldComparator

All Known Implementing Classes:
PaintStrictComparator
public interface FieldComparator
Decides, per column, whether two cell values should count as a difference.

This is the extension point that lets TableComparer stay a generic, pure diff engine while domain-specific comparison rules (ignored columns, per-field tolerances, sentinel equivalences, cross-column corrections) live in their own, individually testable implementation.
